name: @pipeworx/mcp-nuget

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the NuGet .NET package registry by free text. Returns package id, description, authors, total downloads, and latest version for up to 1000 matches; optionally includes prerelease packages.

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: Registration metadata for a package — versions, tags, dependencies, dates.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: All published versions of a package.

tools.name: latest_version
tools.description: Most recent released version of a package.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nuget forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nuget pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
